about.text: Sweet whey concentrated and spray-dried to a powder, still holding its lactose, proteins and minerals. Used in bakery, soups and other processed foods, and in animal feed.

facts.v: In Czechia, dried from whey left over from cheese and tvaroh (cottage cheese) making
A protein-concentrated whey powder with lactose removed is also sold, for sports and health drinks
